headline: Foreign Trade Approves Final Anti-Dumping Duties on Imports of Indian Iron Pipes
summary: Saudi Arabia's Commerce Minister issued final anti-dumping duties on imports of cast iron ductile pipes from India. The pipes range from 100 mm to 1,000 mm and are used in water networks and drainage.
why: Anti-dumping duties protect domestic producers by raising the cost of imports deemed sold below fair value. They affect trade flows between exporting and importing countries.
